subject.title: fix(deepinfra): use OpenAI video end point and tag DeepSeek thinking format

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally retire shipped DeepInfra custom-native video endpoints and require those operators to provide an OpenAI-compatible `baseUrl` after upgrade?
rationale: Source and live proof establish that the new endpoint works, but code evidence cannot decide whether breaking the shipped custom endpoint contract is acceptable product policy.

options.title: Approve explicit retirement
options.body: Land the canonical OpenAI-compatible path with the current doctor notice and accept that custom-native users must reconfigure before video generation works again.

options.title: Preserve custom-native support
options.body: Keep a separately owned native transport path or defer the endpoint switch until a supported compatibility design and upgrade proof are available.

options.title: Split the fixes
options.body: Land the independent DeepSeek dialect correction while pausing the video endpoint migration for a narrower compatibility decision.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit retirement
recommendation.body: Land the canonical OpenAI-compatible path with the current doctor notice and accept that custom-native users must reconfigure before video generation works again.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a shipped provider-config and upgrade-policy choice requiring the repository's product authority rather than contributor-only implementation judgment.
